column2: The Imperial army has begun an invasion of Alkmaar in Basel. It seems to be heading for the Guild.{wait}{clear}And they say the army is led by Alberic Kreutzfeld.
A vampire has appeared in Brenner in Brasia, and the villagers are falling victim one after another.{wait}{clear}Please, destroy this vampire.

In Guaira, in Cadiz, there have been assassinations aimed only at nobles.{wait}{clear}The assassins work as a group, and they seem to act quickly and with careful planning.{wait}{clear}If this goes on, there are fears for its effect on the whole country. Won't you please go and put down the assassins?
They say a boy with a beast in tow has appeared in Rooak, in the Reyforia Forest.{wait}{clear}Will you go there?

Araras in Linares... The Imperial army has begun marching on the Holy City.{wait}{clear}It's far larger than any invasion so far, and it may be too much for you alone...{wait}{clear}But I don't think we can just sit and do nothing.{wait}{clear}I know it's very dangerous, but would you go to the Holy City?
The man called Viper, who stole the Demon Stone, has appeared in the town of Corrientes in Selva.{wait}{clear}Would you take the Demon Stone back from him?
The Imperial army has begun an invasion of Kierang in Tarlac.{wait}{clear}To think the Empire's reach would extend even to Legrance... Will you go to Kierang?
The Imperial army is gathering in the town of Hayil in Riga, and I've heard there are beings there that aren't human.{wait}{clear}Would you go and find out what is happening in the Empire?
A boy with a beast in tow has appeared in the village of Fano in Celesta.{wait}{clear}I don't know the details yet, but before anything happens, would you go to Fano?

In Texel, in Kran, nobles are being attacked again and again.{wait}{clear}It may be the sign that something big is about to happen to the kingdom of Legrance.{wait}{clear}Won't you please go and resolve the matter?

I've had word that demons have slipped into the Imperial army's camp at Carrara in Basel.{wait}{clear}If demons join the Imperial army as it is now, great harm is unavoidable.{wait}{clear}To get a grasp of the Empire's movements too, would you go to Carrara?
Dinar in Ur has been occupied by Titans.{wait}{clear}The nearby villages have been plundered as well, and many people are suffering.{wait}{clear}Won't you please go and drive out the Titans?

In Faro, in Ellora, a band led by a man in red armor has appeared, killing and plundering at random.{wait}{clear}It's close to Fanlan, the capital, so if it's left alone, chaos is certain!{wait}{clear}Won't you please go and stop those men?

At last... the Demon Stones have all gathered in the Empire...{wait}{clear}A tower has been built at Kaluga in Taishut, and they mean to perform the ritual of revival.{wait}{clear}I know danger is waiting for you, but to stop the Heavenly Dragon's revival, won't you please go to Kaluga?

Viper has appeared in Marilia in Brasia.{wait}{clear}Nothing has happened yet, but he was the one gathering the Demon Stones, so there's no telling what he'll do.{wait}{clear}In any case, would you go to Marilia and meet him?
Alberic has appeared in Tara in Brennar.{wait}{clear}He moves his troops only for his own desires. If this goes on, everything will head toward ruin...{wait}{clear}Please, stop Alberic.

In the town of Turta in Ragnitz... one of the heroes who fought beside us has appeared as an enemy.{wait}{clear}It's very hard, and my words may no longer reach them... But I don't want to give up.{wait}{clear}To bring them back to who they were, would you go and see them?

The undead are gathering at Castle Ravenruft in Ragnitz, and they seem to mean to attack humans while the world is in chaos.{wait}{clear}If you defeat Ravenruft, who leads them, the undead will lose their command.{wait}{clear}It's a very dangerous place, but would you go to Castle Ravenruft?
Castle Ravenruft has appeared in Ragnitz. It's eerie, as if it were inviting someone in...{wait}{clear}Will you go to that castle?

Almost at the center of Arcaya... where Lake Dreihaup used to be, a castle has appeared.{wait}{clear}It's the legendary Crimson Moon King's castle... and Endymion, who has now become a devil, is there.{wait}{clear}That is where the final battle will be. To save the world and the people the Heavenly Dragon torments, please go there.
The Imperial army has begun an invasion of Graz in Krakow.{wait}{clear}The frontier towns have few people and no strength to resist the Empire. Won't you please save the townspeople?

It seems the Imperial army has a camp at Slatina for its invasion.{wait}{clear}The frontier has always been thinly peopled. Once the Empire's invasion begins, it will be overrun in no time.{wait}{clear}Won't you please save the people of the frontier?
